data.description:

data.title: Seed Innovations backs Feather Robotics in $7.6m pre-seed push into humanoid AI hardware
data.description:
An update from Seed Innovations Limited GBP ( (GB:SEED) ) is now available.

Seed Innovations has highlighted a key milestone at portfolio company Feather Robotics Inc., which has completed a $7.6 million pre-seed funding round via a SAFE structure led by Gradient Ventures, with participation from several venture firms including SEED. SEED’s previously announced $1 million investment will convert into equity at Feather’s next qualifying round or liquidity event, subject to a $60 million valuation cap, reinforcing the investor’s exposure to early-stage humanoid robotics.

Feather, founded by former Google and Tesla executives, is positioning itself between proprietary, closed-stack humanoid robot makers and lower-cost research platforms by selling modular, deployment-ready humanoid robots at roughly one-half to one-third the price of Chinese rivals. With online-ordered robots priced at $29,990, year-long sales into sectors such as manufacturing and food service, and a product thesis that hardware will be the primary value capture layer in physical AI, the funding supports Feather’s ambitions to scale a developer-focused humanoid platform and strengthens Seed Innovations’ strategic foothold in a fast-evolving robotics market.

data.title: BlackBerry Q2 Results Highlight QNX Record Revenue and Raised Outlook
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from BlackBerry ( (TSE:BB) ).

BlackBerry reported a strong second quarter for fiscal 2027, with revenue rising 26% year-over-year to $163.3 million and adjusted EBITDA up 81%, marking a second consecutive quarter meeting its Rule of 40 metric. The company posted its sixth straight quarter of positive GAAP net income, improved gross margins, generated $29.3 million in operating cash flow, and ended the period with $447.1 million in cash and investments.

QNX delivered record revenue of $80.3 million, driven by automotive strength and its first Alloy Kore design win from Coretura, the largest in QNX history and adding over $100 million to royalty backlog. BlackBerry also expanded its Physical AI ecosystem and secured new certifications and integrations for SecuSUITE and AtHoc, while Secure Communications remained a stable, profitable contributor despite some margin pressure, prompting the company to raise its full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook.
